# order: EO:1971  (WPA 1944: 1914 July 2)
# WPA summary: Dr. Park Howell made eligiblefor retentionas acting as sistantsurgeon in the Public Health Service for a period not to exceed one year without regard to CivilService Rules. 1914 CSR 128.
# book: Thirty-first Annual Report of the United States Civil Service Commission, fiscal year ended June 30, 1914
# scanned image 135, printed page 128; page lines 7-17
# source: https://archive.org/download/annualreport139commgoog/annualreport139commgoog_djvu.xml  sha256 748145327cc4747e27aefe00b5a3e31f5ebe8eb60b92a78e231aeb0237074ab1
# found by: date_and_subject; date 1914-07-02; words howell|surgeon
# Government printed copy (OCR of a compilation or report), not the signed original. A lead for the
# original_text step: read it against the scan before use. Exact slice of the page OCR follows.
----- EXACT SLICE -----
office May 10, 1912, to engage in private business. His reinstatement is recommended
by the present postmaster, which recommendation is concurred in by the Postmaster
General. The Civil Service Commission does not join in the recommendation.
July 2, 1914.
The services of Dr. Park Howell may be continued as acting assistant surgeon in
the Public Health Service, for a period of not to exceed one year, beginning July 18,
1914, without compliance with the civil-service rules and regulations.
This order is recommended by the Secretary of the Treasury because the services
of an additional officer are needed for the above period and there is no commissioned
officer available for assignment to the duty.
July 6, 1914.
